name: ielts-peel-hacker
description: IELTS PEEL Hacker — Skill-first PEEL logic engine for Writing Task 2 / Speaking Part 3 (optional local playground)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "node --watch server/index.js" "node client/node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js --config client/vite.config.js"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build:prompt && npm run sync:skill
scripts.build: npm run build:prompt && npm run sync:skill && node client/node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config client/vite.config.js
